evidence.title: Self-Supervised Graph Representation Learning for In-The-Wild Wearable and Smartphone based Emotion Recognition

summary: Researchers develop a self-supervised graph representation learning method to improve emotion recognition using data from wearables and smartphones. The approach aims to enhance real-world applications by leveraging unlabeled data for more accurate emotional state detection.
title: AI Advances Emotion Recognition with Self-Supervised Graph Learning for Wearables and Smartphones
